svg.title: W-10 Channel settings wireframe
svg.text: With more than one channel, the app bar shows a channel select and Switch (chooseChannel sets the soundcheck-channel cookie).
Disconnect Guitar Garage and delete all of its data from Soundcheck? Access to your
channel is revoked. This cannot be undone.
Revoke, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, then Firestore
Deletion did not finish. Nothing was lost; try again.
Settings stays reachable while status is reauth_required
ChannelCard: the profile from connect and the build state in words (Not started, Queued, Learning how your
audiences watch, Ready, No videos to learn from yet or Ready to build, Failed).
DeleteChannelButton: confirm, DELETE, then router.refresh(). The settings page then has no channel and
→ After a successful delete → /app: "No channel yet" (W-02)
→ Switch → /app with the chosen channel (W-03 or W-04)
